department: Field of Biochemistry, Molecular and Cell Biology (BMCB)

deadline.value: The 2026-27 catalog lists November 16; the department admissions page says December 1. Apply by November 16 to be safe.

also.quote: The deadline for fall admission is December 1; there is no spring admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the official pages fetched.

funding.value: Not stated on the official pages fetched.

entry_route.value: Admitted students have usually majored in biology, chemistry or physics; no GPA cutoff.
entry_route.quote: matriculating students will have commonly majored in one of the many areas of biology, chemistry, or physics

notes: BMCB offers PhDs in Biochemistry and in Molecular and Cell Biology; Genetics, Genomics and Development is a partner field with the same catalog deadline. BMCB and GGD welcome international applicants.
